subject: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Smith <lauren.smith@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Security review & next steps (Acme Health)

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of today
- Use case: Acme Health wants to integrate Redwood’s hosted API for automated patient-note summarization and triage.
- Decision criteria: accuracy on clinical notes, latency (<200ms p95 for short prompts), data isolation controls, and SOC 2 / architectural transparency.
- Timeline: procurement + legal review targeting late May for pilot contract approval; security review to start immediately.

Stakeholder mapping (from the call)
- Economic buyer: Michael Ortiz (VP Product) — owns budget and pilot approvals
- Security / IT lead: Lauren Smith — main contact for technical/security questions
- Procurement: Dana Reynolds — handles SOW and PO
- Legal: Alan Chu — reviewing data processing terms

Immediate next steps (mutual action plan)
1) I’ll send our security questionnaire and initial architecture diagram (intake) — target: today/Tomorrow.
2) You to confirm final list of systems in scope and any specific compliance docs you need (SOC 2, pen test, etc.).
3) We’ll schedule a kickoff call with your security team to walk the questionnaire and scope (30–45m).
4) Redwood to assign owners internally for each artifact.

Attachments I’ll include: redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx, high-level architecture diagram.

If anything above is off, please flag. Proposed kickoff window: Tue 2027-04-06 or Wed 2027-04-07 afternoon PT — does that work?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Lauren Smith <lauren.smith@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Ortiz <m.ortiz@acmehealth.com>, Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@acmehealth.com>, Alan Chu <alan.chu@acmehealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 13:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Security review & next steps (Acme Health)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed stakeholders: I’m the technical/security lead; Michael is the economic buyer and will be looped for budget approvals. Please also include Dana Reynolds (procurement) and Alan Chu (legal) on contract and DPA discussions.
- Systems in scope for initial review: production APIs, the ETL pipeline that sends notes to Redwood, and the analytics/ML feature store.
- Compliance docs we’ll need: current SOC 2 report, code/infra architecture diagram, and any data retention / deletion guarantees.

We’ve attached our procurement_requirements.pdf which outlines PO and contract cadence.

Kickoff: Tue 2027-04-06 11:00 AM PT works for the security team; can your team do that time?

Thanks,
Lauren Smith
Director, IT Security — Acme Health
lauren.smith@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme_procurement_requirements.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Smith <lauren.smith@acmehealth.com>, Michael Ortiz <m.ortiz@acmehealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff: questionnaire intake & systems in scope

Hi Acme security team —

Per our call with Lauren, attaching the intake artifacts to start the review. Please find: 
- redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (Excel — intake questionnaire)
- redwood_architecture_diagram.pdf (PDF — service boundary / network flow)

Quick notes:
- We believe the initial scope is: production API endpoints, the ETL pipeline from Acme to Redwood, and the analytics/feature store. If any of your systems should be excluded or additional ones included (e.g., staging, sandbox), please call that out in the intake sheet.
- Expected turnaround: we typically collect artifacts + answers in ~7–10 business days for initial review; full validation (including any follow-ups) can take up to 2–3 weeks depending on scope.
- Artifacts we commonly provide: SOC 2 report, architecture diagrams, pen-test summary, data flow diagrams, and a signed DPA/NDA if needed.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2027-04-06 at 11:00 AM PT — I’ve tentatively scheduled this slot (invite to follow) to walk the questionnaire and confirm owners.

Attachments: redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 95KB); redwood_architecture_diagram.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Looking forward —
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Prep: Acme Health security questionnaire — ownership & artifacts

Folks —

Acme confirmed kickoff for 11:00 AM PT today. Immediate asks so we don’t delay: 

1) Neha — can you pull the latest SOC 2 report and pen-test summary from the compliance drive and drop into the folder below? Also grab the current DPA template. (Link below)
2) Sean — please prepare the high-level network/dataflow diagram and confirm whether our hosted API endpoints that handle PHI are segmented (we should include hostnames if possible).
3) I’ll own the questionnaire answers for architecture and deployment model sections and will compile the artifact checklist.

Artifact checklist (quick):
- SOC 2 report (latest)
- Pen-test / vuln summary
- Architecture diagram (network + service boundary)
- Data flow diagram showing PII/PHI ingress/egress
- DPA / DPIA if available
- List of sub-processors + data retention policy

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFGHacme-security and HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-4592

I’ll hop on 10 minutes early and run through the intake sheet. Let me know if either of you can’t make the 11:00 slot.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: artifact_checklist.csv (CSV, 3KB)
